meta.title: Auto button resizes rows/columns to Small, Medium, Large or XL

steps.note: Open the prepared QCS containing bid data.
Switch the QCS comparison grid to horizontal view.

args.goal: in the horizontal QCS, open the Auto control, select Small, then Medium, then Large, then XL in turn, and after each selection verify with screenshots that the QCS row height or column width visibly changes to the selected size

steps.note: Perform the Auto size selections and verify the visible resizing for every option.
Confirm the QCS remains rendered without errors or broken values after resizing.
